_comment: Single source of truth for the Brush Pass page. `npm run build` stamps these values
into every element marked data-bp / data-bp-href / data-bp-when, the same way
nerve/release.json drives the Nerve pages. Never edit a URL inside an HTML file.
stage           — closed-testing | open-testing | production. Production since
19 October 2026, when Brush Pass went public on Google Play.
play.listingUrl — the public Play Store listing. Every 'Get it on Google Play' link
points here, and nowhere else. The build refuses a public stage
without it. The links are the site's own text buttons: no Google
badge or logo artwork is used, by Neal's decision on 19 Oct 2026.
ios.status      — 'coming-soon' shows 'iPhone version coming soon.' No date and
no App Store badge until there is a live App Store listing.
Tester recruitment ended at launch: there is no sign-up form or opt-in link any
